categories.main_business_segments: TOHO TITANIUM operates three main business segments: the Metal Titanium segment (including sponge titanium, titanium ingots, high-purity titanium, and titanium processed products), the Catalyst segment (mainly polypropylene polymerization catalysts), and the Chemicals segment (including electronic materials such as ultrafine nickel powder and high-purity titanium oxide).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced titanium smelting and processing technologies, including sponge titanium production and EB (electron beam) melting for ingots. It also utilizes proprietary catalyst manufacturing methods for polypropylene production and specialized processes for producing ultrafine nickel powders and high-purity titanium oxide for electronic components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global aerospace manufacturers (notably for sponge titanium), polypropylene resin producers (for catalysts), and electronic component manufacturers (for ultrafine nickel and titanium oxide, especially for MLCCs). The aerospace, automotive, electronics, and chemical industries are the primary end markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: TOHO TITANIUM has a global footprint, with major sales in Japan, the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company operates manufacturing sites in Japan and has subsidiaries and joint ventures in the US, Europe, and Saudi Arabia, with exports accounting for over 60% of total sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain, supplying raw and semi-finished titanium materials, catalysts, and specialty chemicals to manufacturers in downstream industries such as aerospace, automotive, and electronics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity for titanium (especially in response to aerospace demand), improving catalyst efficiency, and strengthening the supply of ultrafine nickel for next-generation MLCCs. The company is also investing in sustainability (ESG), decarbonization technologies, and new business areas such as porous titanium for hydrogen electrolysis (WEBTi®). R&D focuses on process improvements, product quality, and new applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of products (titanium materials, catalysts, and specialty chemicals) under long-term contracts and spot sales. Some revenue is also derived from technology licensing, technical support, and joint venture arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global titanium producers (such as Titanium Metals Corporation and other international firms), as well as specialized catalyst and electronic material suppliers. TOHO TITANIUM is positioned as a leading Japanese titanium producer with a strong presence in aerospace and electronic materials, and is recognized for its technological expertise and reliability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2024 (ending March 2025), consolidated sales reached 88.97 billion yen, with operating profit of 5.88 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 3.73 billion yen. The company has shown strong growth since 2021, driven by recovery in aerospace demand and expansion in catalysts and chemicals, though profits have fluctuated due to raw material and energy costs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TOHO TITANIUM emphasizes high product quality, advanced technological capabilities, and stable supply, especially for critical applications in aerospace and electronics. Its differentiation lies in its integrated production, proprietary technologies, and responsiveness to customer needs for high-purity, high-performance materials, as well as its commitment to sustainability and ESG initiatives.
